summary: Jeena Sikho Lifecare has commenced operations at a new 17,700 sq ft client support centre in Noida, marking a significant expansion of its customer service infrastructure.

headline: MCX to meet BlackRock on Nov 25
summary: Multi Commodity Exchange of India Ltd will hold a one-on-one meeting with BlackRock in Mumbai on November 25, 2026, as per SEBI disclosures.

headline: Purple Finance clarifies NCD partial redemption
summary: Purple Finance Limited clarifies that the upcoming redemption for its Non-Convertible Debentures is a partial redemption via face value reduction, not an early full redemption.

headline: DCM Nouvelle faces ₹41.66 Cr tax demand
summary: DCM Nouvelle Ltd received a rectification order for AY 2019-20, revising a zero-demand notice to ₹41.66 crore. The company is challenging the order, citing computational errors.

headline: Sabrimala Industries CFO and Director resign
summary: Sabrimala Industries India Limited announced the resignation of CFO Ankit Tiwari and Director Sangeeta Harpalani, effective November 17, 2026.

headline: India electronics exports to exceed $60 billion this fiscal
summary: India's Trade Secretary has predicted that electronics exports will surpass $60 billion in the current fiscal year, signalling strong momentum in the sector.

headline: Popular Vehicles projects FY27 EBITDA margin at 4.2%
summary: Popular Vehicles & Services projects an EBITDA margin of around 4.2% for FY27 and between 4.5% and 4.6% for FY28, signalling a gradual margin expansion trajectory.

headline: Technopack Polymers adds new SACMI line
summary: Technopack Polymers Limited is adding a new SACMI production line to increase capacity by 1.5 crore caps per month, with commercial production expected by March 2027.

headline: Insilco seeks shareholder nod for Evonik RPT
summary: Insilco Limited, under voluntary liquidation, issued a postal ballot notice for members to approve related party transactions with Evonik India Private Limited via e-voting.

headline: Om Infra H1FY27: EBITDA up 72%, PAT falls 90%
summary: Om Infra reported a 15.29% rise in topline and 72.33% EBITDA growth in H1FY27, but net profit dropped 89.97% due to tax provisions.

headline: Liquor firms must pay 75% tax upfront for bulk Scotch
summary: Liquor companies are required to pay 75% of applicable tax in advance for bulk Scotch deliveries, with the remaining balance covered through bank guarantees.

headline: OM Infra eyes growth in water infrastructure sector
summary: OM Infra aims to explore growth opportunities in India's water infrastructure sector, with a particular emphasis on pumped storage projects.

headline: Padam Cotton Yarns gets MCA nod for subsidiary
summary: Padam Cotton Yarns Ltd received MCA approval to reserve the name Padam Entertainments Private Limited for a new wholly owned subsidiary in media and entertainment.

headline: AYM Syntex scheme sanctioned by NCLT
summary: The NCLT Mumbai Bench has sanctioned the amalgamation of Mandawewala Enterprises with AYM Syntex. The scheme is now effective, pending receipt of the formal court order.

headline: GSPL Transmission to meet ICICI Securities virtually
summary: GSPL Transmission Limited officials will hold a one-to-one virtual meeting with ICICI Securities on November 20, 2026. No unpublished price sensitive information will be shared.

headline: South India Paper Mills open offer undersubscribed
summary: Nandini and Kirit Modi's open offer for 26% equity in South India Paper Mills saw minimal public participation, with only 3.24 lakh shares accepted against 48.75 lakh offered.

headline: Titagarh Rail Systems wins ₹65.38 crore traction motor order
summary: Titagarh Rail Systems has secured a ₹65.38 crore order from Chittaranjan Locomotive Works for the supply of traction motors, adding to its railway equipment portfolio.

headline: Texmaco Rail wins ₹2.79 crore order from Northern Railway
summary: Texmaco Rail & Engineering has secured a ₹2.79 crore order from Northern Railway for the production of Weldable CMS Crossings.

headline: ICICI Life RTA KFin shifts office Dec 1
summary: ICICI Prudential Life Insurance announced that its Registrar and Transfer Agent, KFin Technologies, will relocate its corporate office in Hyderabad effective December 1, 2026.

headline: DCB Bank pays interest on Tier 2 bonds
summary: DCB Bank Limited made timely payment of annual interest on its 9.20% Basel III Tier 2 bonds. The bank disbursed ₹36.80 crore to bondholders on the due date.

headline: Insilco sets Nov 20 record date for liquidation payout
summary: Insilco Limited, under voluntary liquidation, fixed November 20, 2026 as the record date for distributing balance liquidation proceeds to shareholders.

headline: Rajeev Kumar Deora acquires 3.98 lakh ICSL shares via gift
summary: Rajeev Kumar Deora acquired 3,98,550 equity shares of Integrated Capital Services Ltd through a gift from his brother, raising his holding to 9.008%.

headline: Syrma SGS invests ₹14.99 crore in subsidiary
summary: Syrma SGS Technology acquired 3,02,298 shares in Syrma Kaga Electronics for ₹14.99 crore via rights issue, maintaining its 60% stake in the joint venture.

headline: South Indian Bank revises MCLR rates from Nov 20
summary: South Indian Bank has updated its MCLR rates effective November 20, 2026, with the one-year MCLR set at 9.55%.

headline: Tata Consumer to hold investor meetings in NY, London
summary: Tata Consumer Products will host one-on-one and group meetings with analysts and institutional investors in New York, London, and virtually from November 30 to December 7, 2026.

headline: United Polyfab appoints three independent directors
summary: United Polyfab Gujarat Limited appointed Nareshkumar Mistri, Rohit Agrawal, and Payal Jangir as independent directors for five-year terms via EGM.

headline: Powerica to host analyst meet in Bengaluru on Nov 24
summary: Powerica Limited will hold a group meeting with investors and analysts in Bengaluru on November 24, 2026, organised by Citigroup Global Markets India.

headline: Typhoon Financial CS resigns effective Nov 18
summary: Richa Shah resigned as Company Secretary and Compliance Officer of Typhoon Financial Services Ltd due to other assignments. The resignation is effective November 18, 2026.

headline: Quadrant Televentures appoints six new directors
summary: Quadrant Televentures Limited appointed six new directors, including Arshdeep Singh Mundi as Whole Time Director, following an NCLT-approved resolution plan by Fastway Transmissions Private Limited.

headline: Onemi Technology Solutions seeks approval for new independent director
summary: Onemi Technology Solutions Limited has issued a postal ballot notice for the appointment of Venkatadri Chandrasekaran as a Non-Executive Independent Director. Remote e-voting begins November 19, 2026.

headline: Eastcoast Steel posts Q2FY27 loss
summary: Eastcoast Steel Ltd reported a net loss of ₹25.13 lakh in Q2FY27, swinging from a profit of ₹4.82 lakh in Q2FY26. Total income fell sharply to ₹14.10 lakh.
